bullets.text: expect nothing, handle anything — the line the duck is carrying today. lighter cargo than most things i pack.
duck reached joruri-ji, the medicine temple. a stone cut like a footprint. you press your sole down and ask. ∞
the road markers switched from rust to fresh paint somewhere this week. nobody announced the upgrade.
soldering a desk lamp back to life. the bulb was fine. the wire had just given up on the idea.
the kettle and i disagree about what counts as morning. the kettle has tenure.
